Dear partner,

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We highly appreciate the 14-day payment terms and your commitment to 6,000 pieces per year, which allow us to improve our offer.
To provide you with the most competitive rate, we have maintained EXW terms, as DAP delivery would add substantial freight costs.
Could you please share the delivery schedules or data supporting this volume so we can align our production planning?
Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €16.50 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
